explanation.headline: FDA's records show cisatracurium besylate is not on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include cisatracurium besylate as of 2026-10-21.

Corvale East holds 39 vials at 3.5 per day for 11.2 days on hand, Corvale General holds 126 vials at 4.1 per day for 31 days on hand, and Corvale Lakeside holds 23 vials at 0.8 per day for 29.6 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Armas Pharmaceuticals, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
Additional alternate manufacturers ranked by rule include Avenacy, LLC and Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc., both not on FDA's shortage list today with labels naming no plant we could place.
